```{python}
#| label: load-metadata
import pandas as pd
import datetime
import os
from bioreport.utils.report_utils import get_project_summary_stats, Sample_Info_table, Sample_Info_table_modern
from bioreport.config import load_project_metadata
project_info = load_project_metadata()
input_files = project_info['input_files']
stats, df_final = get_project_summary_stats(data_dir=input_files.get('data_dir', '.'), qc_filename=input_files['qc_file'], mapping_filename=input_files['mapping_file'], tpm_filename=input_files['tpm_file'], sample_filename=input_files['sample_file'])
total_samples_count = stats['total_samples']
total_groups = stats['total_groups']
total_data_gb = stats['total_data_gb']
avg_q30 = stats['avg_q30']
mapping_rate = stats['mapping_rate']
unique_mapping_rate = stats['unique_mapping_rate']
avg_dup = stats['avg_dup']
genes_detected = stats['genes_detected']
from bioreport.i18n import translate
qc_status_text = translate(stats['qc_status'])
mapping_status_text = translate(stats['mapping_status'])
unique_status_text = translate(stats['unique_status'])
avg_data_per_sample = total_data_gb / total_samples_count if total_samples_count > 0 else 0
current_date = datetime.date.today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
```
## Project Background

This RNA-seq report summarizes the supplied quality-control, alignment and expression results. Project metadata and statistics below are read from the configured input files.

## Key Metrics

Sample and group counts describe the experimental design. Q30 is the percentage of bases with Phred quality at least 30. Mapping and unique mapping rates describe alignment to the configured reference genome. Detected genes have TPM > 1 in at least one sample.

```{python}
#| label: project-kpi-cards
#| echo: false
from html import escape
from IPython.display import HTML, display

def _kpi_card(title, number, unit, note, danger=False):
    classes = 'kpi-card kpi-danger' if danger else 'kpi-card'
    unit_html = "<span class='report-metric-unit'>" + escape(str(unit)) + '</span>' if unit else ''
    return "<div class='" + classes + "'><div class='kpi-title'>" + escape(str(title)) + "</div><div class='report-metric'>" + escape(str(number)) + unit_html + "</div><div class='kpi-note'>" + str(note) + '</div></div>'
_kpis = [_kpi_card('Samples', total_samples_count, 'Samples', f'Includes <strong>{total_groups}</strong> experimental groups'), _kpi_card('Total Data', f'{total_data_gb:.1f}', 'Gb', f'Mean {avg_data_per_sample:.1f} Gb / Sample'), _kpi_card('Sequencing Quality (Q30)', f'{avg_q30:.1f}', '%', escape(str(qc_status_text)), danger=avg_q30 < 80), _kpi_card('Detected Genes', genes_detected, '', 'Genes with TPM &gt; 1'), _kpi_card('Mapping Rate', f'{mapping_rate:.1f}', '%', escape(str(mapping_status_text)), danger=mapping_rate < 70), _kpi_card('Unique Mapping Rate', f'{unique_mapping_rate:.1f}', '%', escape(str(unique_status_text)), danger=unique_mapping_rate < 60), _kpi_card('Duplication Rate', f'{avg_dup:.1f}', '%', 'Sequence duplication', danger=avg_dup > 50)]
display(HTML("<div class='report-kpi-grid'>" + ''.join(_kpis) + '</div>'))
```

## Sample Information

The table lists sequencing and alignment statistics for all `{python} total_samples_count` samples. Mean Q30 is `{python} f"{avg_q30:.1f}"`% (`{python} qc_status_text`). Mapping rate is the percentage of clean reads aligned to the configured reference genome, `{python} project_info['genome']`. Clean reads are reported in millions; insert size applies to paired-end libraries.
